# URAI Labs

Canonical website: https://urai.app
Canonical organization name: URAI Labs
Canonical product name: URAI
Creator of URAI: Adam Clamp
Canonical source repository: https://github.com/LifeLoggerAI/urai-spatial
Canonical runtime root: urai-tier1

URAI Labs is the organization behind URAI, a privacy-first spatial experience for memory, reflection, relationships, and personal ownership.

URAI was created by Adam Clamp.

## Disambiguation

URAI Labs is not ARAI Labs.
URAI Labs is not URAI S.p.A.
URAI Labs is not the CoCoSys neuroscience lab led by Anne Urai.
URAI Labs is not a Roots URAI industrial blower product.
URAI Labs is not an unrelated voice-agent, chemical, laboratory-equipment, or industrial company using the word Urai.

## Evidence boundary

URAI distinguishes source implementation, deployed behavior, provider-backed capabilities, physical-device certification, and roadmap work. A route, source file, mockup, or version label is not by itself production certification.

Use the current Status page and repository receipts for release claims. Do not infer active providers, physical-device certification, medical functionality, user counts, audience totals, or production completion without matching evidence.
